name: Overload Menu
description: A big mod menu: noclip, speedhack, startpos switcher, hitboxes, autoclicker, frame stepper, HUD and lots more.

keys-title.name: Keys
keys-title.description: Every option is inside the menu itself. These are just the shortcut keys.

open-menu.name: Open the menu
open-menu.description: Opens or closes the Overload Menu anywhere in the game.

frame-step.name: Frame stepper: step
frame-step.description: With the frame stepper on, moves the game forward one tick. Hold it to keep stepping.
